description: A self-hosted launcher for the ArtCraft web apps (WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft, PdfCraft, DesignCraft, PhotoCraft) with tabs, dark and light themes, and automatic app updates.
name: artcrafthub
note: Set ADMIN_TOKEN to a long random string. It is the password for the Manage button, where you add, update and remove apps. Visit the port you chose, then press Manage.
title: ArtCraft Hub

env.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
env.label: Admin token (a long random string, used by the Manage button)

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.label: GitHub token (optional, raises GitHub's request limit)
